newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Reuters introduces 3000 series products in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Reuters introduces 3000 series products in Manila.

text.p: Reuters Ltd on Thursday said it introduced its 3000 series of new products for financial markets in the Philippines with demonstrations to clients.

The four products, Markets, Securities, Treasury and Money, incorporate access to a new database of historical and background information with supporting analytics, as well as existing Reuters real-time data.

"The introduction of the Reuters 3000 range of products to the Philippines allows us to provide the most comprehensive real-time and historical data, analytics and multimedia news available in the financial markets today," John Atkinson, manager, Philippines, said.
The Securities 3000 database covers 90,000 equities from more than 80 countries, with up to 15 years of daily price history and full fundamental data on more than 27,000 companies.
Treasury 3000 covers 300,000 bonds from more than 100 countries, with price and yield histories on 50,000 bonds.
Money 3000 has 10 years of daily price histories on 4,000 forex and money rates in 167 currencies, with 40 years of macroeconomic indicators from some 80 countries.

Atkinson said the products also include a facility to send and receive electronic mail securely, a new multi-media news package including Reuters real-time textual news and Reuters Financial Television, and a Netscape browser which enables clients to access data from Reuters private intranet.
